fee_assessment_amounts_valid.name: fee_assessment_amounts_valid
fee_assessment_amounts_valid.value: "membership_fee_assessments"."plan_amount_cents" between 0 and 1000000000 and "membership_fee_assessments"."base_amount_cents" between 0 and 1000000000 and "membership_fee_assessments"."reduction_cents" between 0 and "membership_fee_assessments"."base_amount_cents" and "membership_fee_assessments"."amount_cents" between 0 and 1000000000

cashbook_entries_payment_unique.name: cashbook_entries_payment_unique
cashbook_entries_payment_unique.where: "cashbook_entries"."payment_id" is not null and "cashbook_entries"."reverses_entry_id" is null

cashbook_entry_amount_valid.name: cashbook_entry_amount_valid
cashbook_entry_amount_valid.value: ("cashbook_entries"."reverses_entry_id" is null and "cashbook_entries"."amount_cents" between 1 and 1000000000 and "cashbook_entries"."reversal_reason"='') or ("cashbook_entries"."reverses_entry_id" is not null and "cashbook_entries"."amount_cents" between -1000000000 and -1 and length(trim("cashbook_entries"."reversal_reason"))>0)

report_template_years_valid.name: report_template_years_valid
report_template_years_valid.value: "finance_report_templates"."valid_from_year" between 1900 and 2200 and ("finance_report_templates"."valid_to_year" is null or "finance_report_templates"."valid_to_year" between "finance_report_templates"."valid_from_year" and 2200)

fiscal_year_closing_valid.name: fiscal_year_closing_valid
fiscal_year_closing_valid.value: ("fiscal_years"."status"='open' and "fiscal_years"."closed_by" is null and "fiscal_years"."closed_at" is null) or ("fiscal_years"."status"='closed' and "fiscal_years"."closed_by" is not null and "fiscal_years"."closed_at" is not null)

event_coordinates.name: event_coordinates
event_coordinates.value: ("event_occurrences"."latitude" is null and "event_occurrences"."longitude" is null) or ("event_occurrences"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "event_occurrences"."longitude" between -180 and 180)

compliance_deadline_done.name: compliance_deadline_done
compliance_deadline_done.value: ("compliance_deadlines"."status"='done')=("compliance_deadlines"."completed_on" is not null and "compliance_deadlines"."completed_by" is not null)

insurance_policy_types.name: insurance_policy_types
insurance_policy_types.value: cardinality("insurance_policies"."coverage_types") between 1 and 3 and array_position("insurance_policies"."coverage_types", null) is null

volunteer_snapshot_chain.name: volunteer_snapshot_chain
volunteer_snapshot_chain.value: ("volunteer_register_snapshots"."snapshot_number"=1 and "volunteer_register_snapshots"."previous_snapshot_id" is null and "volunteer_register_snapshots"."previous_sha256" is null) or ("volunteer_register_snapshots"."snapshot_number">1 and "volunteer_register_snapshots"."previous_snapshot_id" is not null and "volunteer_register_snapshots"."previous_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

volunteer_time_confirmed.name: volunteer_time_confirmed
volunteer_time_confirmed.value: ("volunteer_time_entries"."status"='confirmed')=("volunteer_time_entries"."confirmed_by" is not null and "volunteer_time_entries"."confirmed_at" is not null)

mail_message_source.name: mail_message_source
mail_message_source.value:
case "mail_messages"."kind"
        when 'fee_reminder' then "mail_messages"."person_id" is not null and "mail_messages"."assessment_id" is not null and num_nonnulls("mail_messages"."user_id", "mail_messages"."event_id", "mail_messages"."deadline_id", "mail_messages"."newsletter_id") = 0
        when 'event_invitation' then "mail_messages"."person_id" is not null and "mail_messages"."event_id" is not null and num_nonnulls("mail_messages"."user_id", "mail_messages"."assessment_id", "mail_messages"."deadline_id", "mail_messages"."newsletter_id") = 0
        when 'deadline_reminder' then "mail_messages"."user_id" is not null and "mail_messages"."deadline_id" is not null and num_nonnulls("mail_messages"."person_id", "mail_messages"."assessment_id", "mail_messages"."event_id", "mail_messages"."newsletter_id") = 0
        when 'newsletter' then "mail_messages"."person_id" is not null and "mail_messages"."newsletter_id" is not null and num_nonnulls("mail_messages"."user_id", "mail_messages"."assessment_id", "mail_messages"."event_id", "mail_messages"."deadline_id") = 0
        else "mail_messages"."user_id" is not null and num_nonnulls("mail_messages"."person_id", "mail_messages"."assessment_id", "mail_messages"."event_id", "mail_messages"."deadline_id", "mail_messages"."newsletter_id") = 0
      end

mail_message_resolution.name: mail_message_resolution
mail_message_resolution.value: ("mail_messages"."resolution" is null) = ("mail_messages"."resolved_at" is null and "mail_messages"."resolved_by" is null) and ("mail_messages"."resolution" is null or "mail_messages"."resolution" in ('retry','mark_sent','dismiss'))

community_news_no_deadline.name: community_news_no_deadline
community_news_no_deadline.value: "community_posts"."kind"='poll' or ("community_posts"."closes_at" is null and "community_posts"."closed_at" is null)

inventory_loan_return.name: inventory_loan_return
inventory_loan_return.value: ("inventory_loans"."returned_on" is null) = ("inventory_loans"."return_condition" is null) and ("inventory_loans"."returned_on" is null) = ("inventory_loans"."returned_by" is null) and ("inventory_loans"."returned_on" is null or "inventory_loans"."returned_on" >= "inventory_loans"."issued_on")
